Section 6 unconditionally revokes the parent EO:12757 and EO:13131; no savings, accrued-rights preservation or exception continues this order's operative force. Successor foreign-affairs delegations and Board rules in EO:13345 sections 1-5 rest on that new order and do not save the former order. The judicial-review limitation concerns rights under this order and does not independently continue the revoked delegations or amendment commands. The bounded OFR later-instrument and eCFR searches are adequate for this no-order claim; no affirmative revival or residual lead is present.

research_rationale: Read and audited the full frozen original EO:13131 and the complete full-dossier contexts of EO:12823, EO:13028 and EO:13345. Original text and the 17 corrected exact command spans are unchanged: title amendment, two preamble changes, four section 1 changes, two section 3(b) changes, three section 3(c) changes, changes to sections 4(a), 4(c)(1), 4(c)(2), replacement of section 4(d), and the independent judicial-review limitation. EO:12823 (1992) and EO:13028 (1996) establish the preexisting parent text upon which this 1999 order operates; their complete texts contain no prospective condition terminating the later 1999 commands. In particular, EO:12823 changes original section 4(d) from four to five private members, and EO:13131 then replaces the five-member provision and adds the two additional FAA members; this confirms the operative amendment target rather than an earlier end of EO:13131. EO:13028 adds the second functions-vested sentence containing the section-571(a)(2), (c) and (d) delegation, and EO:13131 section 1(c)(4) adds the enumerated section-808 functions to it; the added functions do not repeal the retained 571 delegation. The frozen chain correctly removes the time-reversed earlier-order actor lead and contains only the direct EO:13345 revocation as a later target event. No own-term sunset, report deadline or occurrence-triggered end appears. EO:13345 section 6(d) hereby revokes this order unconditionally; its full July 8, 2004 date and absence of postponed effectiveness establish the effective first end of each retained command, rather than the later filing or publication dates. EO:13345 sections 1-5 independently establish successor delegations and Board governance and section 7 limits review; none saves the former order as independent authority. The machine missing-list references to EO:12823 and EO:13028 are not substantive absences because their complete held contexts have now been read. The unchanged OFR catalog/held-operative-text and cutoff eCFR searches remain adequate bounded later coverage; no affirmative revival or residual lead is present. The U.S. Code release through October 9 is not used to assert a current predicate. Frozen original metadata changes grade to original_representation_unverified while retaining acceptable_as_original true and requires_page_check false; complete official-text identity, URL and source/text hashes are unchanged, and original_pages_confirmed remains false. No conflicts are enumerated.
